mainEntity.name: How do I get accurate pricing for a tenant improvement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurate pricing starts with a clear scope, measurements, finish selections, and a definition of what is included and excluded. Pricing becomes more reliable when the contractor has enough detail to estimate labor, materials, permits, and coordination work instead of guessing.
